radius.meaning: Load travel per motor-shaft radian; drum radius / gear ratio

inertia.meaning: Rotational inertia at shaft, excluding suspended mass

brake_torque.meaning: Static and sliding brake torque capacity at shaft

brake_release_delay.meaning: Delay from RELEASE command to physical release motion

brake_application_delay.meaning: Delay from APPLY command to physical application motion

crane_height.meaning: Initial clearance below load; maximum downward travel

peak_motor_torque.meaning: Peak magnitude of the assumed torque-slip curve

peak_slip.meaning: Slip magnitude at peak motor/generator torque

reference_volts_per_hz.meaning: V/f at which the peak torque parameter is defined

capacitor_capacitance.meaning: Each of three delta-connected AC capacitors

rotor_resistance.meaning: Dynamic model: rotor resistance referred to stator

rotor_leakage.meaning: Dynamic model: referred rotor leakage inductance

saturation_flux.meaning: Flux where nonlinear magnetizing current is twice its linear value

initial_flux.meaning: Initial residual-flux seed; initial condition, not a hysteresis model

precharge_voltage.meaning: Capacitor-bank target supplied by the 24 V precharge converter

initial_shaft_rpm.meaning: Dynamic model: shaft speed at Reset

ac_load_resistance.meaning: Balanced star AC test load; larger values mean lighter load

excitation_response.meaning: Exciter voltage / flux feedback response time

motor_rated_voltage.meaning: Nameplate voltage; reference for the overview voltage bar

rectifier_resistance.meaning: Effective averaged bridge/source resistance; limits charging current

dc_brake_resistance.meaning: DC equivalent brake resistance; smaller draws more current at a given voltage

chopper_threshold.meaning: Chopper starts requesting duty above this DC voltage

chopper_band.meaning: Voltage rise above threshold for a full-duty request

chopper_response.meaning: Averaged chopper duty response time constant

inverter_current_limit.meaning: Phase current limit of the active exciter

inverter_reactive_current_limit.meaning: Reactive phase-current component limit of the active exciter

inverter_output_resistance.meaning: Virtual output impedance used by the averaged current controller; not heat

inverter_conduction_resistance.meaning: Physical equivalent inverter conduction resistance used only for heat

inverter_idle_loss.meaning: Enabled converter overhead; legacy DC-fed mode also requires minimum DC voltage

inverter_min_dc_voltage.meaning: Below this voltage the averaged exciter is disabled

battery_initial_soc.meaning: Battery state of charge at Reset

boost_target_voltage.meaning: Auxiliary regulated DC output; separate from brake DC link in battery-exciter mode

boost_input_power_limit.meaning: Maximum battery input power to the boost converter

boost_output_current_limit.meaning: Boost high-voltage output current limit, including initial charging

aux_capacitance.meaning: Auxiliary high-voltage DC-link capacitor between boost and exciter

aux_ready_voltage.meaning: Minimum auxiliary-link voltage for field-building readiness

precharge_power_limit.meaning: Battery converter limit while precharging AC capacitors

charger_power_limit.meaning: DC-link to battery charger input-power limit

charger_min_dc_voltage.meaning: DC-link voltage at which battery charging may begin

core_loss_resistance.meaning: Approximate core-loss branch referred to stator terminals

gearbox_efficiency.meaning: Lowering gear efficiency; gravity-referred loss torque

drivetrain_loss_torque.meaning: Bearing/seal Coulomb loss torque at motor shaft

external_supply_voltage.meaning: Legacy comparison only; unused by the finite battery-exciter model

exciter_active_limit.meaning: Maximum positive exciter AC active output

exciter_run_active_limit.meaning: Maximum positive exciter AC power after brake release

exciter_absorption_limit.meaning: Deprecated compatibility input; reviewed exciter never absorbs AC real power

maximum_magnetic_flux.meaning: Maximum allowed estimated magnetizing flux before V/f derating

motor_current_limit_rms.meaning: Maximum intended machine phase-current magnitude for scalar V/f control

overcurrent_dwell.meaning: Time above the machine-current limit before a protection fault

minimum_control_frequency.meaning: Minimum intended controlled exciter frequency before mechanical braking

sequence_normal_hold.meaning: Canonical hold after reaching normal frequency

sequence_slowdown_1_hold.meaning: Canonical hold after reaching first slowdown target

sequence_slowdown_2_hold.meaning: Canonical hold at minimum controlled frequency

sequence_stop_speed.meaning: Speed below which a physically applied brake qualifies STOPPED

runaway_min_export_power.meaning: Minimum useful export while diagnosing current-limited runaway

runaway_dwell.meaning: Duration of runaway evidence before FAULT

startup_flux_fraction.meaning: Required flux fraction before automatic brake release

dc_precharge_resistance.meaning: Series resistance from bridge to main DC capacitor while K_PRECHARGE is closed

dc_precharge_close_fraction.meaning: Main-contactor close threshold relative to available rectified crest voltage

dc_precharge_timeout.meaning: Maximum precharge duration before a latched startup fault
